sectors.trend: Iron ore crash confirmed; China demand pivot and steel job cuts (Whyalla) signal structural softening. Gold exploration active in WA (Forrestania, PLC Resources). Battery graphite (Sarytogan) shows progress.
sectors.implications: BHP.AX, RIO.AX, FMG.AX face near-term earnings pressure. Gold names (GOLD.AX, NGX.AX) and graphite/battery materials offer relative strength. Diversify away from iron ore concentration.

sectors.trend: ANZ.AX restructuring post-3,500 cuts faces execution risk. House price weakness and no auction bounce raise NPL concerns. Superannuation system under scrutiny. Private hospital operator breakup affects healthcare lending.
sectors.implications: CBA.AX, NAB.AX, WBC.AX, ANZ.AX face margin pressure from rate cycle and credit risk. Monitor NIM trends. Super fund managers (HUB.AX, PPT.AX) face policy risk.

sectors.trend: Australia nearing energy inflection point. Oil spike pressuring airlines and consumers. LNG and renewables transition accelerating.
sectors.implications: WDS.AX, WLE.AX, SXG.AX benefit from oil strength. Airlines (QAN.AX) face cost pressure. Renewable energy names gain policy tailwind.

sectors.trend: Major private hospital operator breakup via lender-backed consortium signals sector consolidation. Pfizer dividend concerns noted globally.
sectors.implications: CSL.AX, SWL.AX, IAG.AX (health insurance) face M&A and consolidation dynamics. Monitor hospital operator debt restructuring.

sectors.trend: Nvidia 2GW Australia AI data centre push. AI spending debate (Alphabet $200B, Anthropic slowdown calls). AI agent monitoring (Datadog, Dynatrace) emerging.
sectors.implications: Australian data centre REITs and power infrastructure (SGH.AX, IAG.AX) benefit. Global tech volatility (NVDA, CRM, PANW) transmits to ASX tech names.

sectors.trend: House prices falling, no auction bounce. Alcohol consumption declining. Flight cancellations (1 in 3 days) disrupt travel. Yen strength impacts travel demand.
sectors.implications: REITs (GPW.AX, ICPS.AX) face occupancy and valuation pressure. WES.AX, WOW.AX under consumer spending stress. QAN.AX, DLO.AX hit by oil and staffing.

risk_assessment.mitigation: Reduce BHP.AX/RIO.AX/FMG.AX exposure; rotate into gold and battery materials; hedge with commodity futures

risk_assessment.risk_factor: Housing price correction spilling into bank credit losses
risk_assessment.mitigation: Monitor NAB.AX/CBA.AX provision ratios; favour WBC.AX with lower residential exposure; hold quality REITs only

risk_assessment.risk_factor: Oil spike increasing input costs and inflationary pressure
risk_assessment.mitigation: Favour energy producers (WDS.AX, WLE.AX); underweight airlines and consumer discretionary

risk_assessment.risk_factor: ANZ restructuring execution failure post-3,500 cuts
risk_assessment.mitigation: Avoid ANZ.AX until cost-out plan shows earnings inflection; prefer CBA.AX, NAB.AX for financials exposure

risk_assessment.risk_factor: Immigration policy disruption to labour supply and growth
risk_assessment.mitigation: Monitor RBA commentary; favour productivity-driven sectors over labour-intensive construction

risk_assessment.risk_factor: Geopolitical risk: China-US tensions and Trump regime dynamics
risk_assessment.mitigation: Maintain gold allocation (GOLD.AX, NGX.AX); diversify away from China-exposed commodity names

opportunities.recommendation: Overweight WA gold exploration and production names
opportunities.rationale: Forrestania 2Mt deal and PLC Resources discovery signal active WA gold pipeline; gold hedges iron ore weakness and geopolitical risk

opportunities.rationale: Oil spike plus domestic energy transition supports WDS, WLE, SXG; structural demand for LNG and renewables

Private hospital operator breakup creates consolidation opportunities; CSL remains quality compounder

No auction bounce, falling house prices, and potential NPL build threaten occupancy and valuations

defensive_moves.recommendation: Hedge with quality dividend payers and gold
defensive_moves.rationale: Stock shock building; Fed meeting uncertainty; geopolitical risk elevated. Defensive income and gold provide downside protection

defensive_moves.recommendation: Avoid ANZ.AX until restructuring shows earnings inflection
defensive_moves.rationale: 3,500 job cuts create execution risk; grand plan has long runway; prefer CBA/NAB for financials

market_outlook.short_term: ASX faces headwinds from iron ore crash and building stock shock, partially offset by oil strength and Fed meeting optimism. Expect volatility around ^AXJO. Materials underperform; Energy and Gold outperform. AUD/USD pressured by commodity mix shift. RBA on hold but hawkish bias if oil-driven inflation persists.
market_outlook.long_term: Structural rotation away from iron ore toward gold, battery materials, energy transition, and AI infrastructure. Housing correction may extend 6-12 months, pressuring banks and REITs. Immigration policy overhaul could support medium-term growth if managed well. AI capex cycle in Australia is multi-year positive. Healthcare consolidation creates M&A opportunities.
